tokenName: Securities Exchange Community Grain Receipt Token
underlyingAsset: Certified community grain and produce deposits — Egypt
description: Securities Exchange lists tokenised warehouse receipts from smallholder farmers and rural cooperatives in Egypt. Any farmer with certified stored produce can list their receipt on this exchange, attracting institutional buyers and creating immediate liquidity for rural communities. Minimum lot size is 1 bag of produce.
regulatoryFramework: Egypt Warehouse Receipts Act; Securities Exchange Commodity Listing Rules

tokenName: Securities Exchange Digital Service Contract Token
underlyingAsset: Tokenised gig and informal service contracts — Egypt
description: Service workers, artisans, freelancers and gig economy participants in Egypt can tokenise their service contracts on Securities Exchange. Each token represents a verified contract, enabling service workers to attract working capital financing from investors. Electricians, tailors, plumbers and IT contractors all benefit from this financial inclusion instrument.
regulatoryFramework: Egypt Financial Markets Act; Egypt Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Public Works Employment Token
description: Listed on Securities Exchange, this PPP contract token finances public infrastructure in Egypt — roads, schools, hospitals and clean water. Token holders receive revenue-sharing distributions while simultaneously supporting national employment creation.
regulatoryFramework: Egypt PPP Act; Public Works Employment Tokenisation Policy

description: Anyone in Egypt with as little as one unit of local currency can co-own affordable housing through Securities Exchange. regulatoryFramework: Egypt Financial Markets Act; Egypt Digital Assets Regulatory Framework 2024

tokenName: Securities Exchange Daily Labor Proof Token

regulatoryFramework: Egypt Labour Act; Informal Economy Tokenisation Framework 2024
